run_filter_overthink: run the script to filter LLM benchmark responses using a verifier model and keep only hard questions
call_llm: call an LLM via LiteLLM with a single message and sampling parameters
call_llm_mp: call an LLM in batch mode for multiple messages with configurable temperature and top_p
score_response: score a verifier LLM response by parsing Final Decision tags into a binary 0 or 1
normalize_mcq_options: normalize MCQ answer options from lettered keys A through L into a unified options list
